name: Cannibal Sweetheart
source:
Dealing with a heart disease is never fun, is it? You're in the late stages and your doctors say you're gonna die without your surgery. Such a shame you can't afford it. But maybe you don't have to when a certain heart muncher approaches you with a deal. A life saving surgery in exchange for a date. You'd practically be stupid not to accept! It's not like you have any other choice, after all.

Casanova Valentine has you right where he wants you.

[From [url=https://vomitalgia.itch.io/cannibal-sweetheart]Itch.io[/url]]
